chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ali ibn Asbaat, raising it, said:
Oiling the two eyebrows with violet oil removes the headache.
ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of using violet oil on the eyebrows according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the integration of practical medicine (al-Tibb) with prophetic tradition, illustrating how the Imams utilized accessible natural remedies for common ailments like headaches. It underscores the Shia scholarly view that the Imams possessed comprehensive knowledge of both spiritual and physical healing, validating the use of simple, organic treatments within a religious framework.

en.hubeali: Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ali Bin Asbaat, raising it,
‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Oiling the two eyebrows removes the headache’.
en.sarwar: 9. Sahl ibn Ziyad has narrated from Ali ibn Asbat in a marfu‘ manner has said the following: “He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Applying viola oil to one’s eyebrows dispels headaches.’”
